title: Prove the Package Behind the Green Light

ciFast.note: Fast verification reruns release, format, lint, unit, build, and bundle gates after push.

ciDeep.note: No adapter-versus-base promotion or external quality claim is made in this compiler release.

deploy.note: Production deployment remains downstream of the successful main verification run.

liveProvider.note: The pinned base-only Scion route completes all five frozen courses plus a fresh Physical Geology regression with zero findings, blockers, warnings, model failures, or archive failures.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, classroom, human-preference, factual, or independent-model validation is claimed.

manualBrowser.note: Representative DOCX files, every-DOCX defect scans, console receipts, manifests, quality reports, and all six physical ZIPs were inspected.

claims.summary: All fifteen requested Mandarin lesson identities receive exact attributed CHN101 facts from one trusted compiler-owned source contract.
Public, local, and shim routes project direct trusted facts with zero native model calls and truthful telemetry.
proofCommands: npx vitest run tests/public-scion-provider.test.js tests/scion-local-provider.test.js tests/scion-stream-reader-local.test.jsx

claims.summary: NFKC comparison and boundary-aware identity matching preserve valid Chinese knowledge without cross-lesson false matches.

Exported assessment weights, misconception options, constructed-response keys, and shortened references render without duplication, broken narrators, prompt echo, article collisions, lowercase sentence starts, missing apostrophes, possessive-plus-article seams, or cross-conjunction focus fragments.
Five frozen base-only courses and a fresh Physical Geology regression each complete ten material sections, 38 export checks, and valid archives at 99/A with zero findings, blockers, or warnings.

The exact five-course build uses 31 actual Gemma generations, including one bounded content retry, and Geology adds four for a six-course total of 35 with zero failures rather than reopening the old 72-call per-course architecture.
Current Scion safety copy uses AI-generated materials and the package surface retains one finished Download ZIP action.
proofCommands: rg -n 'every AI draft|Download draft ZIP' src/screens/Config.jsx src/components/ExportSidePanel.jsx
